title: Roads, potholes, and back-road driving
summary: Feedback centers on how the G60 is experienced on narrow, pothole-damaged, side, and back roads, but most sampled fragments do not state a clear overall sentiment about the car itself.

positive.summary: One positive review says the car is comfortable to place near the edge on narrow roads.

negative.summary: One negative review describes pothole-damaged local roads as unpleasant, while noting the car is much better on motorways.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention potholes, rough Texas roads, side-road routing, back-road use, and poor navigation on smaller country roads without enough context to classify overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
Several fragments describe road conditions or navigation context rather than a direct evaluation of the vehicle.
The topic mixes road-surface comments with routing and navigation behavior, so it is not fully coherent as a single aspect.
